12                I stand in support of this 

13   legislation.  This bill is entitled Erin Merryn's 

14   Law.  This is a piece of legislation that's

16   years.  Unfortunately, it has yet to be taken up 

17   in the Assembly.

18                Erin Merryn was a young woman who is 

19   extremely brave, who was sexually abused multiple 

20   times by neighbors and family members when she 

21   was young and told her story all over the 

22   United States.  She's trying to pass a version of 

23   this legislation in every state in the union.  

24   She's been successful in about five states thus 

25   far.  And certainly New York would be a turning 


                                                                2844

 1   point in making sure that this bill is supported 

 2   throughout the country.

 3                It takes a very simple approach.  It 

 4   requires that the State Education Commissioner 

 5   make recommendations to the Regents relating to 

 6   the instruction to prevent child sexual 

 7   exploitation and child abuse.  Right now this is 

 8   not a mandate.  This bill would not create a 

 9   mandate, but it would at least give the State 

10   Education Department the authority, through the 

11   Regents, to make recommendations to make sure 

12   that our young people are made aware of the 

13   telltale signs of child abuse.

14                This is something that's important.  

15   This is something that can certainly save lives.  

16   And I'm hopeful that this bill not only passes 

17   the Senate again this year but is taken up and 

18   passed in the Assembly, thus becoming law.  

19                Thank you, Mr. President.
